From: Eleni Papadaki <sales@aegeanbreeze.example>
To: Contracting Team <contracting@sunnybreaks.example>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:42:00 +0200
Subject: RE: RE: Aegean Breeze Resort - Summer 2027 rates

Dear Tom,

Thank you for the call. OK, we agree: for Season B we can do 84 on the Standard Double HB and 112 on the Junior Suite HB. All other prices stay as in my first mail. We also need release 10 days instead of 14, as agreed.

Please send the signed contract back by end of the week.

Kind regards,
Eleni Papadaki
Sales Manager, Aegean Breeze Resort, Kos

-----Original Message-----
From: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@sunnybreaks.example>
Sent: Friday, 13 November 2026 16:05
Subject: RE: Aegean Breeze Resort - Summer 2027 rates

Hi Eleni,

Thanks for these. Season B looks high versus the market – could you do 80 on the Standard Double HB and 110 on the Junior Suite HB? Happy to commit to the allotment as you proposed. Also, 14 days release is long for us, can we go shorter?

Best,
Tom
SunnyBreaks Holidays – Contracting, Greece & Cyprus

-----Original Message-----
From: Eleni Papadaki
Sent: Wednesday, 11 November 2026 09:18
Subject: Aegean Breeze Resort - Summer 2027 rates

Dear Tom,

As promised, our proposal for summer 2027 (15 May – 15 October 2027). Prices are per person per night in EUR, commissionable at 18%.

Rooms:
- Standard Double (2-3 adults, max 1 child)  -> allotment 8 rooms
- Junior Suite (2-3 adults, max 2 children, max 4 pax) -> allotment 3 rooms

Season A 15/5-30/6 (min 3 nights)
Season B 1/7-31/8 (min 5 nights)
Season C 1/9-15/10 (min 3 nights)

Half Board, pp/night:  STD  62 / 88 / 66     JSU  92 / 118 / 96
All Inclusive: + EUR 25 pp/night on top of HB, all seasons, all rooms.

Children sharing with 2 adults: 0-5.99 free, 6-13.99 50% discount.
Release: 14 days.
Cancellation: free up to 21 days before arrival, 8-20 days 30%, 7 days or less 100%.
Special offer: Stay 7 pay 6 in Season A and Season C, not combinable.
Climate resilience fee EUR 4.00 per room per night is not included, payable by the guest on arrival.
Payment: 50% deposit 30 days before arrival, balance 7 days after check-out.

Looking forward to your feedback.

Eleni
